summary: A Sporting News betting guide to NBA Rookie of the Year futures, naming Victor Wembanyama as the early favorite ahead of Scoot Henderson and Chet Holmgren. It explains how to place a futures bet at legal online sportsbooks, profiles four sportsbooks, and weighs the pros and cons of betting early versus waiting. It also lists ROTY winners since 2010.
one_line: Sporting News guide to 2023-24 NBA Rookie of the Year odds, led by Victor Wembanyama, with betting steps, sportsbook picks and past winners.
key_facts: Victor Wembanyama, the San Antonio Spurs rookie coached by Gregg Popovich, is described as a generational talent and the early favorite for NBA Rookie of the Year.
Wembanyama has a 7-foot-4 height and an 8-foot wingspan, which the article credits for his elite defense.
Scoot Henderson of the Portland Trail Blazers is positioned as Damian Lillard's successor, supported by Anfernee Simons and Jerami Grant, after a season with the G League Ignite.
Chet Holmgren of the Oklahoma City Thunder is a 7-foot player whose scoring ranges from the paint to the 3-point line and whose passing is called underrated.
To bet on ROTY, open an account at a legal online sportsbook, go to the basketball section, select the NBA, open the futures tab, choose the bet, enter the amount and finalize the bet slip.
The article warns that offshore sportsbooks are illegal and offer no protection against fraud and other criminal activities.
The sportsbooks recommended for NBA ROTY odds are DraftKings, FanDuel, BetMGM and Caesars.
Betting early on ROTY gives better odds but carries higher risk and less information, since a player's performance, health and team dynamic can change.
Waiting to bet gives more information and avoids backing a player not in contention, but sportsbooks tighten the lines and reduce the potential return.
The ROTY trophy is referred to as the Wilt Chamberlain Trophy.
Paolo Banchero of the Orlando Magic won the 2023 NBA Rookie of the Year award, following Scottie Barnes in 2022 and LaMelo Ball in 2021.
Damian Lillard won Rookie of the Year in 2013 with the Portland Trail Blazers, and Tyreke Evans won in 2010 with the Sacramento Kings.
The NBA is the second-most popular odds market in the US, behind the NFL.
